# Check the CAM math before you argue about the bill.

> Free CAM reconciliation calculator for small commercial landlords and tenants. Check area-share math, credits, billed charges, and variance privately in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [This calculator vs. AppFolio CAM reconciliation](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cam-reconciliation-check/vs-appfolio.html)
- [This worksheet vs. reconciling CAM by square footage alone](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cam-reconciliation-check/vs-square-footage-alone.html)
- [This calculator vs. Yardi Voyager CAM reconciliation](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cam-reconciliation-check/vs-yardi.html)
